refunds.title: How refunds work
refunds.body: Buyers can request refunds after delivery depending on seller policy and order status. Sellers process refunds from the order detail page. Partial refunds are supported for shipping-only adjustments when the item is kept.

verificationDocs.title: Re-uploading verification docs
verificationDocs.body: If verification was rejected, open Seller verification, review the moderator note, replace the affected documents, and resubmit. Make sure EDRPOU, tax number, and banking details match your uploaded files.

payoutsFees.title: Payout schedule & fees
payoutsFees.body: Krydix releases seller payouts after the configured hold period once delivery is confirmed. Commission depends on category rules set by the platform. Check Seller dashboard for pending and completed payouts.

bulkImport.title: Bulk-importing products
bulkImport.body: Use Seller → Import to upload CSV or XLSX templates. Validate the preview, fix row errors, then confirm. Updates match products by SKU within your catalog.

cancelOrder.title: Cancelling an order
cancelOrder.body: Buyers can cancel before shipment from order details when the status allows it. Sellers should cancel from their order view if the item cannot be fulfilled and add a short reason for the buyer.
